popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: With twin Procles, first Heraclid kings of Sparta after the Return — Eurysthenes the elder whose line becomes the Agiad house.

popCulture.title: Heracleidae
popCulture.description: The Return of the Heracleidae installs Eurysthenes and Procles as dual founders of Sparta's two royal lines.

popCulture.title: Eurysthenes
popCulture.description: Twin Heraclid founder-king of Sparta; ancestor of the Agiad dynasty through Agis.
